user.title: Connect ESP32 displays
user.description: One connection for all panels. Create a long-lived access token in your Home Assistant profile (Security) - ideally for a dedicated user without admin rights - and use it on every panel. Add the panels afterwards.

data_description.ha_url: How the panels reach Home Assistant, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8123
data_description.token: Profile -> Security -> Long-lived access tokens. The same token is typed into every panel once.

data_description.ha_url: How the panels reach Home Assistant, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8123
data_description.token: A new token only has to be typed into the panels that still carry the old one.

reauth_confirm.title: Token no longer valid
reauth_confirm.description: The access token of this integration was deleted or expired. Enter a new long-lived access token.

error.invalid_auth: This is not a valid access token of this Home Assistant.
error.not_long_lived: This is a short-lived token. Create a long-lived access token in your profile.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one ESP32 Display connection is needed - add more panels to it.

user.title: Add display
user.description: Type exactly this name on the panel's setup page, so it finds its layout. Design the layout afterwards with the ESP32 Display card.

data_description.name: If you rename it, change the name on the panel's setup page as well.

error.name_too_long: The name may be at most 31 characters (umlauts count double).
error.name_taken: A display with this name already exists.
